result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but there are a few visual problems: the promotional banner text has very poor contrast (white/light text on a pale green background), a category chip is awkwardly clipped at the right edge, and horizontally scrolling content is truncated without clear affordance. Overall 4 issues found: 1 critical, 1 major, 2 minor.

issues.description: The promo banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is white/very light on a pale mint-green background, making it nearly unreadable and failing WCAG contrast requirements.
issues.suggestion: Change the banner text to a dark color (e.g., dark green or near-black) or darken the banner background so text meets at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is hard-clipped at the screen edge without ellipsis styling, making the name look broken rather than intentionally truncated.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis within the card bounds, or add horizontal padding/peek spacing so partially visible cards look intentional.

issues.description: A category filter chip after 'Healthy' is cut off at the right edge showing only a thin sliver, which looks like a rendering glitch.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing or add a fade/gradient edge on the horizontal chip list so partially visible chips clearly indicate scrollable content.

issues.description: The star rating and review count '4.8 (500+)' for Tokumaru Ramen Bar sits on the same baseline as the restaurant name but is visually crowded against the right edge, and the '-20%' pizza card below is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scroll container so the last card isn't obscured by the nav bar, and ensure consistent spacing between the rating block and the screen edge.
